'''Sebulba's private apartment''' was the residence of the notorious [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Located on the second floor of a building in the town, it was luxuriously furnished. It also had a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] for home defense. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while searching for an alternative way inside the [[Captain Neg's house|home]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Neg]] in order to rescue the young [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Tomo]] after being refused entry, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] accidentally ended up in the apartment, where he encountered two of Sebulba's female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] slaves, a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] and a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]], who warned him that Sebulba would be angered if he discovered Jinn there. The laser cannon then emerged and opened fire on Jinn, but the Jedi Master was able to destroy it before leaving the apartment.
